decisions.reason: Higher mixing quality and consistent foam are stated as reasons for selecting smaller bowls, but their existing required outcomes are not changed.
The rejection of 8 qt bowls for aesthetic reasons does not change the existing green accent requirement or establish a color change.
Selecting smaller bowls does not change the DJ-turntable visual theme or decorative-control styling.
Smaller bowls may help satisfy the existing enclosure-size constraint, but the required enclosure form factor itself remains unchanged.
The source changes bowl capacity and does not change the existing splash-control target.
The bowl-size decision does not alter the machine placard text.
The source does not change the spout's mounting location, orientation, or pouring access.
Changing bowl capacity does not alter the requirement to prevent liquid from reaching the base or electronics.
The source does not change the spout cleanability or required cleaning method.
The smaller-bowl selection does not change the valve behavior, dripping constraint, or required dispensing flow.
The bowl-capacity decision has no entailed effect on the prototype's 120V power source.
The CAD deliverable must reflect design decisions, but its required artifact format and deliverable obligation remain unchanged.
